options.text: This deployment creates an Azure Function App and an Azure Data Explorer cluster and database to collect Azure Policy history data for reporting.

elements.name: FunctionAppName
elements.label: Function App Name
elements.toolTip: Globally unique name for the Function App that ingests Azure Policy history into Azure Data Explorer.

validations.message: Use 2-60 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens. The name must start and end with a letter or number.

options.text: Azure Policy History Report Portal UI Version: v0.0.13

elements.name: ScheduleCron
elements.label: Schedule (Cron)
elements.toolTip: Six-field NCRONTAB expression used by the timer-triggered Function App. The default runs once daily at midnight UTC.

validations.message: Enter a six-field cron expression, for example: 0 0 0 * * *

options.text:
Common schedules (six-field NCRONTAB, UTC):
• Every day at midnight: 0 0 0 * * *
• Every Monday at midnight: 0 0 0 * * 1
• 1st of every month at midnight: 0 0 0 1 * *

elements.name: Tags
elements.label: Tags JSON
elements.toolTip: Optional JSON object of tags to apply to deployed resources. Example: {"Environment":"Prod","Owner":"Platform"}

validations.message: Enter a JSON object, for example {} or {"Environment":"Dev"}.
